Ravi (ml-eng): quick post: ran a shadowbench of progressive-accept decoding on ember-7b-q3f for translation workloads. putting numbers and config below.
Nina (applied): sweet, what's the headline?
Ravi (ml-eng): throughput ~1.9x tokens/sec vs baseline. median latency dropped ~14ms (p50 26ms vs baseline 40ms). BLEU for WMT holdout down 1.8 pts, chrF down 1.2.
Parker (infra): 1.9x wow. Is that with CPU-assisted scoring or pure GPU?
Ravi (ml-eng): pure GPU with a tiny async scorer on a sibling thread to avoid stalls. acceptance uses a local criterion: token_gap > accept_threshold AND relative_entropy < entropy_thresh.
Yara (ops): any infra noise? saw a couple small GC pauses earlier.
deploy-bot: node/12 GC pause recorded at 9132460015 (minor). No task restarts.
Ravi (ml-eng): run excerpt: 
```
model: ember-7b-q3f
variant: progressive-accept-v1
samples: 6k (WMT subset)
metrics: {tps: 1900, baseline_tps: 1000, p50: 26ms, baseline_p50: 40ms, bleu: 28.2, baseline_bleu: 30.0, chrf: 56.1, baseline_chrf: 57.3}
```
Nina (applied): BLEU drop is nontrivial. is it concentrated on long sentences or named entities?
Ravi (ml-eng): initial slice: long sentences (>50 tokens) show bigger regressions (BLEU -3.6). named entities precision drops a bit 1% false-nes. hypothesis: early acceptance truncates candidate rescoring that would have fixed entity casing.
Parker (infra): can we capture n-best scaffolding info to replay scorer decisions? might help debug.
Ravi (ml-eng): added detailed per-step logs: `acceptance.score_gap`, `acceptance.entropy`, `replay.nbest` in the next run. config: 
```yaml
progressive_accept:
  accept_threshold: 0.18
  entropy_thresh: 2.1
  lookahead_k: 3
  async_scorer: true
  replay_logs: true
```
Yara (ops): let's not roll this into prod until we have human checks. can we schedule a blind A/B with linguists?
Nina (applied): yes, I'll assemble 120 example pairs focused on long-form and entity-heavy segments. blind evaluate for adequacy and fluency.
Ravi (ml-eng): also going to try tuned thresholds (0.12, 0.15, 0.2) and compacting lookahead_k=1/3 to see trade-offs. will run grid across q3f and q4f.
Parker (infra): reserving `shadow-b` pool (4 nodes) for the grid and a quiet window at 9132461000. tagging infra team.
Parker (infra): ack reserve created.
qa-bot: scheduled blind A/B job 9132460500 queued on shadow-b at 9132460028.
Ravi (ml-eng): abort criteria: if BLEU drop > 2.5 OR human adequacy delta > 4% worse we won't promote. also watch p99 latency (should remain < 350ms).
Nina (applied): adding a targeted entity test and a translation-quality quickcheck rubric.
Yara (ops): FYI we'll set alert: p99 > 330ms for shadow-b.
Ravi (ml-eng): one more note: progressive-accept helps bursty chat-style translation use cases a lot (fewer tokens, faster feedback). but for high-fidelity offline translation we may need conservative thresholds.
Nina (applied): thanks. ping once the grid finishes and when blind A/B results are in. :raised_hands:
